title: Dialogflow Update Command
description: Command sent from the application to feature-server over the session websocket, sending input into a running Dialogflow CES session (a `dialogflow` verb with `model: "ces"`) without restarting the verb. The same object can be sent over REST as the `dialogflow_update` key of the call-update body. `variables` and `dtmf` are sent at once. An `event` or `text` starts an agent turn; CES silently drops one that arrives while the agent is still replying, so jambonz holds it and sends it when the agent's current turn ends, one per turn, in order. A command sent when no CES dialogflow verb is running is refused and logged by feature-server.

data.description: The input to send. At least one of `event`, `text`, `dtmf` or `variables` is required, and at most one of `event`, `text` and `dtmf`.

event.description: A CES event name. The CES agent's instructions must say what to do when it receives this event.

text.description: Text sent as if the caller had said it.

variables.description: CES session variables. Only variables the CES app declares, and whose instructions reference them as {name}, are used by the agent.
